title: Sum of Squares
goal: Square everything, add it up. Three pieces, one order.
hints: A slice isn't an iterator yet - something has to start the flow.
sum() is a consumer: it ends the pipeline, so nothing can come after it.
explanation: Pipelines have a shape: an adapter source (.iter()), transformations (.map()), then exactly one consumer (.sum()) that drives the whole thing and produces the final value. Any other order fails to compile - the slice has no .map, and sum()'s output (i32) has no .iter. Once the shape is instinct, iterator chains read like sentences.
